too_large: The request is too large: at most {size}.
no_recording: There is no upload of this recording yet. Upload it, then send again.
bad_from: from must be a whole number, 0 or more.
bad_time: Each sentence’s start and end must be numbers.
live_gap: Sentences are missing before this one. Send again from {next}.

no_question: Send a question, or the time you tapped (at).
op_id_reused: This id was already used for another question.
ask_busy: Two questions are being answered now. Ask again once one is answered.
